title: Assign local decisions before deployment
description: Clinical, technical, and operational owners contribute distinct readiness evidence to a local release and change decision. Publication approval and local deployment approval remain separate.

nodes.label: Clinical owner
nodes.body: Scope, source currency, exceptions and adaptations

nodes.label: Technical owner
nodes.body: Data mappings, dependencies, interfaces and tests

nodes.label: Local release and change decision
nodes.body: Review readiness and unresolved findings. Record approval, rollback, update responsibility, and feedback route.

notes.text: A publisher approval, profile-valid package, or successful execution does not authorize patient care.
Legend: boxes identify responsibilities; arrows identify inputs to a reviewed local decision.
